description: Schema definition for Sales Order Line Items that stores detailed information about individual items within a sales order

id.desc: Unique identifier for the sales line item (nullable)

company.desc: The company associated with the sales line item; references the Companies schema's name field

salesOrderId.desc: Identifier for the related sales order

salesOrderNumber.desc: Sales order number associated with the line item

salesOrderDate.desc: The date of the sales order associated with the line item

sequence.desc: Sequence number of the line item within the sales order

itemId.desc: Identifier for the item being sold; references the Items schema's id field

lineType.desc: Type of the line item; references the Items schema's type field

lineObjectNumber.desc: Object number for the line item, used for further identification

description.desc: Primary description of the sales line item

description2.desc: Secondary description for the sales line item

unitOfMeasureId.desc: Identifier for the unit of measure used for the item

unitOfMeasureCode.desc: Code representing the unit of measure for the item

quantity.desc: Quantity of the item in the sales line

discountAmount.desc: Discount amount applied to the line item

discountPercent.desc: Discount percentage applied to the line item

discountAppliedBeforeTax.desc: Indicates if the discount is applied before tax

taxCode.desc: Tax code applicable to the line item

taxPercent.desc: Tax percentage rate applied to the line item

totalTaxAmount.desc: Total tax amount for the line item

invoiceDiscountAllocation.desc: Allocation of invoice discount to this line item

netAmount.desc: Net amount for the line item after discounts

netTaxAmount.desc: Net tax amount applicable to the line item

netAmountIncludingTax.desc: Net amount for the line item including tax

shipmentDate.desc: Shipment date for the line item, referencing the posting date of the corresponding SalesShipment

shippedQuantity.desc: Quantity of the item that has been shipped

invoicedQuantity.desc: Quantity of the item that has been invoiced

invoiceQuantity.desc: Quantity of the item to be invoiced

shipQuantity.desc: Quantity of the item to be shipped

itemVariantId.desc: Identifier for the variant of the item, if applicable

locationId.desc: Location identifier related to the line item

accountId.desc: Account identifier related to the line item
